description: React component for a dropdown menu to manage channel members, including role changes and removal actions in Mattermost.

methods.name: handleRemoveFromChannel
methods.description: Handles removal of a user from a channel, including leaving the channel if the current user is the target.

methods.name: handleMakeChannelAdmin
methods.description: Triggers role update to make a user a channel admin.

methods.name: handleMakeChannelMember
methods.description: Triggers role update to make a user a channel member.

methods.name: updateChannelMemberSchemeRole
methods.description: Updates the role scheme of a channel member, either admin or member.

methods.name: renderRole
methods.description: Returns the JSX element or label representing the user's role in the channel.
